# Where this stands (2026-11-09, ~1 AM US Eastern)

**Read first:** `docs/RESULTS.md` (all valid experiments, generated by `python src/report.py`),
`docs/IDEAS.md` (the credit-assignment ideas and the offline evidence behind them), `docs/DECISIONS.md`
(every judgement call, with measurements; "Attempt 4" onward is the current setup).

## Setup
Experiments run on **verl-agent** (`/workspace/verl-agent`, own venv, our changes in
`src/verl/verl-agent.patch` on top of `src/verl/VERL_AGENT_COMMIT`) on one A100 40 GB, with the paper's
prompt/response format, full fine-tuning, all six ALFWorld task types and the same 128 validation
games for every arm. Arms are launched by `src/verl/run_arms.sh <arm>` (one at a time), run exactly 34 iterations each (no
wall-clock cap), and differ only in `algorithm.gaca.*`. The instance has **no persistent volume**: the branch `a100` is mirrored to the
private HF repo `Adammouedden/gaca-term-project` by `src/verl/hf_backup.sh` (HF token in `models/token`,
git-ignored). Final probe weights go to the private `Adammouedden/gaca-term-checkpoints`.

## Done
Controls GRPO (14.1%) and GACA (18.8%, p=0.26 vs GRPO); treatments GACA + m_z (12.5%) and GACA-LOO
(11.7%); base model 4.7%. Offline: GACA's step score is ~85% within-state noise; entropy token
weighting does not track decision importance; the **commitment probe** does (1.65x [1.57, 1.74] at the
training config, consistent across task types and game halves).

## Latest result
`gaca_probe` (seed 0) finished at **7.8%** (10/128): below GACA's 18.8% task by task (18 vs 4 games,
McNemar p = 0.004) and below GRPO's 14.1% (14 vs 6, p = 0.12). Its updates were larger and noisier than
GACA's throughout (docs/IDEAS.md, 1b). The queued variants test the two leading explanations.

## Running / queued (automatic)
**`src/verl/queue_runner.sh`** runs the arms listed in **`src/runs/verl/queue.txt`**, one at a time, top to
bottom -- edit that file to reorder, add or drop arms (the runner reads its first line only when it is
ready for the next arm). Queue: `save_smoke` (1-iteration check of the final-weights upload),
`gaca_probe_s1` (seed 1), `gaca_probe_c05` (clip [0.5, 2]), `gaca_probe_pos` (probe weights on positive
advantages only). Every arm uploads its final bf16 weights to the private HF repo
`Adammouedden/gaca-term-checkpoints/<arm>`; after each arm the runner regenerates docs/RESULTS.md,
commits, pushes `a100` and fast-forwards + pushes `main`, and backs up to HF.
